title: Audience segment
description: A named rule over account behaviour, plus the materialization the audience job most recently produced.

slug.description: Stable handle a marketer types. Unique, and never reused after retirement.

description.description: Why this segment exists, in the marketer's words.

clauses.description: Conjunction of predicates. All must hold for an account to be a member.

member-count.description: Size at the last materialization. The only view of membership a marketer gets.

materialized-at.description: When the audience job last evaluated the clauses. Absent before the first run.

min-size.description: Floor below which the segment is refused as too small to target. Defaults to 1000 in the job.

clause.description: One predicate over an account's aggregated behaviour. Never over a single order.

fact.description: Aggregate the clause tests. The closed set is the whole privacy boundary.

value.description: Right-hand side. An array is only meaningful with the in operator.
